title: IntegralTensorComparisonSystem
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and index finite intermediate fields $E\subset\Omega$ with integer rings $R_E$. Use ordinary module derived tensor and perfectness [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor], with the normalized balanced scalar comparisons of [lem-sf-perfect-scalar-tensor-coherence]. An integral tensor comparison system consists of arbitrary $R_E$-linear additive symmetric monoidal categories $C_E$ with bilinear tensor, perfect-valued linear additive functors $F_E:C_E\to D(R_E)$ and coherent symmetric strong monoidal comparisons; transition functors for inclusions, additive and linear over integer inclusions, with coherent symmetric strong monoidal structures, identity comparisons, and monoidal tower comparisons; and natural isomorphisms $\phi_{L/E}:F_LT_{L/E}\simeq B_{R_L/R_E}F_E$. The validity predicate requires both identity-tower equations, monoidality of the identity and tower comparisons, identity and tower equations for $\phi$, and its tensor and coefficient-unit squares with the normalized balanced scalar tensorator. Identity inclusions are included. This record asserts no existence.
